metadata.lookahead_policy: outcome candles open at or after replay timestamp; no candle data before the signal timestamp is scored
metadata.forming_candle_policy: reconstruct 1h/4h/15m in-progress candles from completed 5m bars before the boundary plus boundary 5m open only; no post-boundary OHLCV is exposed
metadata.incomplete_outcome_policy: INCOMPLETE_DATA unless all 864 expected 5m candles from the signal timestamp through the 72h expiry are contiguous or TP/SL is reached before a gap
